note: Sierra NF campground on the north shore of Huntington Lake near Lakeshore, under fir and pine; a forested loop nearer the water and a sunnier loop toward the resort. Boats can be moored near some sites. Run by a concessionaire. --Claude
summary: Deer Creek (Sierra NF, Huntington Lake): rec.gov 232813 confirmed; $47 -> $49-52 (2026-27 peak; doubles $97); 28 sites (27 reservable), max 40 ft; flush toilets, water, no showers; FS season June - September; max stay 14. Lakefront -> lakeview recommended (lakefront-tagged sites 9-13 and 20 are ~42-51 m back under canopy, ~10 m above the water). Phone empty -> (559) 893-2308. Note fixed (north shore, not south).
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront -> lakeview (recommendation; stored value is not --AWH): rec.gov tags sites 009, 010, 011, 012, 013 and 020 'Lakefront' (sold by the night at $52), but on Esri they sit ~42-51 m from the beach/high-water line (Huntington is a reservoir; measured to the upper beach edge, not the drawn-down water), under fir/pine canopy and behind trees and a shoreline trail, with pads roughly 10 m above the water on a slope (DEM site 020 2144 m vs shore 2132 m) - fails the kayak test and the open-ground test. 'All sites have a view of Huntington Lake' supports lakeview. Site coords: 009 37.25142,-119.17910; 011 37.25142,-119.17849; 012 37.25153,-119.17820; 013 37.25169,-119.17797; 020 37.25184,-119.17568.
